Method of Attack: Remote backdoor in firmware allowing remote shutdown of Bitcoin mining equipment
Firmware backdoor checks in with central service auth.minerlink.com and stops mining if response is 'false'
Allows shutting down large sections of global Bitcoin hashrate
Outbound connections from Antminer bypass standard inbound firewall rules
Attack Vector: Firmware backdoor in Bitmain mining equipment communicating with auth.minerlink.com domain
Indicators of Compromise: Serial number, MAC address, IP address sent during check-in
